cc_updates.body: Added CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL to choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses. Added Idle compaction row to /config for turning idle compaction off or back on. Added notice to /design-sync and /design-login that standalone Claude Design (claude.ai/design) closes by December 14, 2026. Fixed 'Prompt is too long' error when stopping a turn while the conversation was being compacted. Fixed requests failing with 'diagnostics: Extra inputs are not permitted' after switching to Vertex or Bedrock mid-session. Fixed Read tool loading an image file of any size entirely into memory; image sources over 128 MB are now refused. Fixed /autocompact and /effort saving to wrong model when a gateway names Opus 4 or 4.1 with a prefix.

Added CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS for unattended retry mode. Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to claude-api skill. Added % motion to vim mode. Added rows to a mod's Input for multi-line text fields. Added classifier_verdict and permission_mode to OpenTelemetry tool_decision events. Fixed quitting removing a worktree made by a WorktreeCreate hook without asking.

Added virtualText to a mod's prompt decorations. Added cache_creation_5m_tokens and cache_creation_1h_tokens to OpenTelemetry api_request event. Added $.ui.view({ agentId }) for mods. Added dir prop on a mod's Text for right-to-left text. Added /advisor on Claude Platform on AWS. Added OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic-convention attributes to trace spans.
